question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(1)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**combating**" means taking action to reduce or prevent something undesirable, such as climate change. (लड़ना)
 
• The context of the sentence is about the Government of India's commitment to addressing the issue of climate change. **"Combating climate change"** is an appropriate phrase, indicating serious efforts and actions taken to tackle the challenges posed by climate change.
 
• The other options: "**replicating**" (नकल करना), "**marking**" (चिह्नित करना), and "**insinuating**" (संकेत देना) do not convey the same sense of proactive engagement in addressing climate change.

Therefore, the correct answer is **‘Option 3’**.

**Complete Sentence:** The Government of India stands committed to **combating**__ climate change.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Replicating (नकल करना):** To make an exact copy of something; to repeat.

 
 
• **Example:** The scientists are replicating the experiment to verify the results.
 
 
 
• **Marking (चिह्नित करना):** To pay attention to; to take notice of; to set a sign or signal for something.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher is marking the students' attendance.
 
 
 
• **Insinuating (संकेत देना):** To suggest or hint something bad in an indirect and unpleasant way.
 
 
• **Example:** The article was insinuating that the politician was involved in corrupt practices.
